sections.heading: UTILIZING NATURAL ENERGY:
sections.content: Utilizing natural energy, also known as passive design or passive solar design, involves harnessing the energy provided by the sun, wind, and other natural elements to enhance the energy efficiency and comfort of buildings. This approach minimizes the reliance on mechanical systems and maximizes the benefits of local climate conditions.
